welcome.title: Welcome to BlockingBear
welcome.text: The app is installed correctly. Follow these short configuration steps to get started.

key.title: OpenRouter management key
key.intro: Enter your OpenRouter Management key. Note: <u>it is not a normal API key</u>, read below how to get it.
key.how1: Open this link, or go to the “Management Keys” section of OpenRouter.
key.how2: Choose “+ New key”, give it a name (e.g. blockingbear) and copy the value.
key.how3: Paste it below: it is verified with OpenRouter before being saved.
key.label: Management key
key.already: A management key was already saved by a previous attempt. You can keep it or replace it.

admin.title: Admin password
admin.intro: The administrator account is named admin, choose its password.
admin.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
admin.already: The “admin” administrator already exists and has its OpenRouter key. Continue with the next step.

terms.title: Terms to always anonymize
terms.intro: Optional: the model automatically recognizes the personal information to anonymize, but it is not perfect. We recommend entering below the information (for example the company name or first and last names) that you are sure you always want anonymized. You can edit the list later from the Settings page.

categories.title: Categories to anonymize
categories.intro: Choose which categories of information the model must anonymize for every user. The ones already enabled are the most reliable: you can widen the selection later from the Settings page, or narrow it per project or chat.
categories.allWarning: Warning: enabling every category increases the likelihood of false positives (text anonymized by mistake). At least at the beginning it is advisable to proceed with the default categories.

chat.title: Chat rules
chat.intro: Two choices that apply to every user. They can be changed at any time from the Settings page.
chat.policyHelp: You can choose whether to force every user to always run anonymized chats only, or not. With the “Optional” setting, normal chats without the anonymization engine are allowed too.
chat.zdr: Allow models without Zero Data Retention
chat.zdrHelp: Some models use providers that declare they collect chat data. With this flag off, models without compliant providers cannot be used.

model.title: Default chat model
model.intro: Optional: the model a new conversation opens with by default, for every user (each user can later pick their own). It can be changed at any time from the Settings page.
model.noCatalog: The model catalogue is not available right now: you can set the model later from Settings.

access.title: Models visible to users
access.intro: Optional: non-administrator users can see the whole catalogue or only the models you select here. The default model chosen in the previous step is always included. It can be changed at any time from the Settings page.
